title: Dargonzine volume 1, issue 1
summary: DargonZine Volume 1, Issue 1 is the inaugural issue of a fan-fiction magazine that carried on the Dargon Project, a shared-world fantasy setting that had been central to the earlier FSFNet electronic magazine. The issue gathers five stories and an editorial. Max Khaytsus continues "Unlikely Partners," in which a thief named Kera and a swordsman named Rien are drawn into a plot involving lycanthropy, a crooked alchemist, and the crimelord Liriss. Other pieces include Michelle Brothers's "Runaway," which follows a young woman fleeing a violent household, and John Sullivan's "Steel Souls," a character study of Ittosai before he became Castellan of Connall. John Doucette's "Inquiries" introduces foreign intrigue, and M. Wendy Henniquin opens the new serial "Trial by Fire." The stories share a medieval-style setting with swords, magic, guilds, and political danger. The magazine also described its plan to publish other non-Dargon speculative fiction under a separate editor.
